trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the game. There is no online trophy and no DLC requirement, so the platinum is a purely single-player grind. PowerPyx rates the set 4 out of 10 and estimates about 200 hours, with A Long Road (100% completion) the hardest single step. Work through the roadmap stages in order and the platinum unlocks last, automatically.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1, so you cannot miss it — just play the story. No special requirement beyond completing the mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Pure story progress; it pops when the chapter's final mission ends. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter anyway — the game has no mission replay, so a save is your only way back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same as the other chapter trophies: pure story progress, unmissable as long as you complete the chapter.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story progress; it unlocks when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story progress; the last chapter trophy before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. This is the gold story trophy and the last story beat before the endgame cleanup. Make a manual save before the final mission — with no mission replay, you cannot re-run it if you want a different route or missed something inside it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a hidden story trophy, so it stays masked in your list until it pops. Story missions cannot be missed — finish the mission and it is yours.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A hidden story trophy tied to one heist mission; finish the mission and it unlocks.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Hidden story trophy for one story mission; finish it to unlock.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Hidden story trophy for one story mission; finish it to unlock.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Hidden story trophy for one story mission; finish it to unlock.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Hidden story trophy for one story mission; finish it to unlock.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the hardest trophy in the set and the gold that gates the platinum. PowerPyx notes the thresholds are lenient — roughly 60% of true completion counts — and that it needs the post-story checklist finished: story, collectibles, activities and the world tasks this guide tracks. Do it last, after the story, and tick off each category in the roadmap.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts build up naturally while driving — jumps, airtime and near-misses all count toward the running total. Check your count under Progress and keep driving aggressively; it is a grind, not a skill test.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The tracker counts 9 activity types; open the touchpad, then Progress, then Activities to see which you have tried and which remain. One try each is enough — you do not need to win or master any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. PSN tracks 42 challenges across 12 shooting-range locations. Learn each range's scoring, then run them one by one — gold is the only medal that counts.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. PSN tracks 14 locations. Win one race at each — you do not need to win every race, just one per location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts as long as the event is different — repeat wins on the same event do not add to the count. Work through the race list across Leonida.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take the challenge; out-fish him to win. Fishing is one of the 9 activities, so the attempt also counts toward Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine in the world and finish one full game. Any arcade game counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the stranger and side characters with a mission strand; finish his last mission and the trophy pops. Side strands unlock as you explore Leonida — talk to strangers and follow their missions to the end.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as the other side-character finals: follow Kenton's strand to its last mission and finish it.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission and finish it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore; each strand is a short chain ending in a final mission. Finish any 8 strands — the five named side characters (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward this, plus other strangers you meet.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its last mission and finish it.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand to its last mission and finish it.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. PSN tracks 18 spots. THIS IS THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: PowerPyx reports the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, disappears after that chapter — and there is no mission replay. Meditate there during Chapter 1, then find the other 17 spots as you explore. Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 as insurance.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand involves hunting; track down the unique animal he asks for and hunt it. No published guide has pinned down the exact animal yet — the game is a day old — so the description is the only confirmed fact so far.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Finish any 3 full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-world photo and tagging activity; use it at 100 different spots. The counter is per location, so visit new places rather than repeating the same one.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small tasks scattered across activities and the world; the counter ticks up as you finish them. Fifty is the target — keep an eye on the count under Progress.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level and escape the heat. Bring your partner along, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and escape together. Positioning matters: both of you must get clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row while the wanted level stays up — plan a route with three close shops and keep moving between them.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles register as you find and drive them around Leonida. Variety helps: new models count, repeats do not.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus with at least five enemies in range and clear all five before it ends. Pick a crowded fight and line the shots up first.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Head to Vice City International Airport and leave in an aircraft without a scheduled flight — take a plane and get airborne on your own terms.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank — stealing one from a military area is the reported route, and it draws a 3-star wanted level. Once you are driving the Rhino, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Detection at any point voids the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Plan each vault job and get clear after the take; five successful escapes complete it.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop a truck, take its cargo, and get away clean.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. PSN tracks 52 areas. Visit every region of the map — the counter ticks up as new areas register.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. PSN tracks 9 gangs. Hit one illegal operation per gang — nine jobs in total, one for each gang's turf.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar spot on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail, and take it in. A quiet world moment, not a mission.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's glass and out the other side — the classic GTA exit.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through on the shot.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description points to a shared moment with your partner that draws a crowd — no published guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet, so treat this as an open lead: try partner activities in busy places and watch for the pop.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count of 500 against this trophy, but what exactly it counts is not documented in any published guide yet. It accumulates as you make choices through the game — keep playing and the counter climbs.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The name hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something that failed the first time. No published guide has pinned down the trigger yet — an open lead, not a confirmed route.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The name hints at a strange or unexplained event in the world. No published guide has pinned down the trigger yet — an open lead, not a confirmed route.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. From a moving vehicle, knock people over with a melee attack — like bowling pins. Line up a group and swing through them.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts and the total climbs to $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts — clothes, weapons, food, cars. It adds up across the whole game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. PSN tracks 8 garages. Buy every garage property on the market.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register vehicles you own or find — ten registrations complete it.
